note: Synthetic frames of the KilaKila guest chat socket (docs/modules/M5.13-kilakila.md), read as the socket of roomId. Each case is one or more frames in order: a string is a text frame as written, {"b64": ...} a binary frame. The shapes follow S07-live and S08-live-full (content as a JSON string with escaped slashes, inside the payload JSON string, inside the Socket.IO event); names, ids, avatars and times are made up.

cases.name: the join: the connect_error event with code 0, then the namespace's 40 (the shape of S07 and S08)
the namespace's 40 with a comma is the join too; other namespaces and the default one are not
a refusal: connect_error with another code, with none, or with the code as text
a Socket.IO error packet on the namespace is a refusal
the server leaves the namespace or closes the transport
Engine.IO packets that hold nothing: open, pong, noop, ping, upgrade, empty
a chat line with every field (the shape of S08-live-full)
a chat line of S07's shape: the user id a number
chat text: trimmed and kept with its line breaks; blank, missing or not text is no line
names and user ids: text or numbers; other types are empty
levels: whole numbers and numeric text; anything else is none
message ids and times
a time out of range
another broadcast's message is skipped; a missing room_id or one written as a number is this room's
content: an object instead of a JSON string, bad JSON, missing, not an object
the payload must be a JSON string with a body
gifts are not shown: 220 and the gift line 10004
the room state 637: watchNumber is the listeners now
room state boundaries: zero, negative, text, missing, bad escapes, bad UTF-8, plain JSON, an object
other kinds hold nothing: entries, leaves, likes, ranks, activities, the end
the kind written as text is not a kind
other events and other namespaces
a binary frame is not read
an event with an acknowledgement id is not read
